text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of the "Summer 
Training Camp." To hone her skills for the 
Kikuka Sho, the days of focused, intensive 
training begin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin felt out of her element in 
an environment with more social 
interaction than usual, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to a hidden spot the Trainer found 
to help her unwind, she calmed her mind 
and was able to tackle the training camp 
at her usual pace.
